subject: sg
title: (R)SG.------TR.
description: First of two diagrams in MP(I)-4 (Music and Politics, Level One — sixties activism). The prose on the preceding page names the structural problem: it would 'not be correct to view the functionalism in this period as "a successful revolution" by any means. Instead, the real significance of this period might lie in what this junction means for black people as we enter the eighties — that being, the nature of how sixties functionalism has helped to set the stage for transitional functionalism of the second degree.' The crossing diagrams the route the sixties' source initiation actually traveled: (R)SG (the reality of source initiation — what the radical political activism of the sixties actually initiated) is crossed with TR (transformation — what that initiation was supposed to become). (R)SG sits at the bottom left with the subject-arrow, and its main line rises straight up to TR. One line leaves the main line, running right to A-PR (all-purpose). From A-PR's line a vertical drops to IF-SPT (infra-spirituality), with MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) branching from it, and a long line runs down-right to DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center), with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branching from it, TRS (transition) dropping from T-C-IMP's line, and POL-DYM (political dynamics) branching in turn from TRS.
